project_info.name: ICF Operations Hub
project_info.description: Unified web app for ICF contractors handling bracing calculations, equipment rental, estimating, and inventory management.
project_info.tone: Rugged, professional, precise, no-nonsense, high legibility.

guidelines: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings larger than 32px.
Use leading-none for headers and leading-relaxed for body.
Never use 'Inter' or generic sans for headings.
Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
Use Safety Orange (#EA580C) sparingly for primary CTAs and active states.
Avoid completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

surface_strategy.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-zinc-200), no shadow.
surface_strategy.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-sm), border darkens.
surface_strategy.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border (border-zinc-200). No glassmorphism as it reduces legibility in sunlight.
surface_strategy.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layout for data grids.
surface_strategy.radius: Subtle roundness. Max 4px or 8px border-radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Avoid heavily rounded corners.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 text-white hover:bg-orange-700 rounded-sm font-semibold tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 rounded-sm font-medium

components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with sharp corners, zinc-200 borders, focus:ring-orange-600.
components.tables: Dense, highly legible tables with sticky headers. alternating row colors (zinc-50/white) for easy scanning.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts) with high-contrast color palettes.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-600 focus:outline-none).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform duration-200, transition-colors duration-200).

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='bracing-calc-submit').

media_and_images.strategy: Use authentic construction photography. Avoid generic 3D renders. Focus on real workers, concrete, and tools.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all dashboard views are fully responsive, with mobile layouts tested for legibility in bright sunlight (high contrast).
Use Phosphor icons for dense dashboard navigation and actions.
The Bracing Engine must be the focal point, utilizing structured forms with clear validation and large, readable output metrics.
Avoid glassmorphism or soft shadows. Use solid backgrounds with 1px borders.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, links, and key outputs.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Rely entirely on the provided image_urls.
